transcript: One of the hardest paths you will ever walk is the path of healing alone. When I say heal alone, I do not mean to live without love. I mean to stop searching for others to fill the emptiness you feel inside, to stop dating when your heart is not ready, to stop running from your silence by surrounding yourself with noise, parties and endless distractions. True healing begins the moment you sit in stillness with your pain. It is uncomfortable. Yes, it feels like drowning in emotions you once buried. But when you allow yourself to truly feel, you begin to free yourself. No one can carry this work for you. It is not fair to use others to patch what is broken within. The space inside you can only be filled by you. Through meditation, prayer, journaling, movement and quiet reflection, through awareness, through courage, you begin to rebuild your inner world. And one day, when you are whole, you will meet others not from need, but from peace. Heal alone. For it is in solitude that the soul remembers its strength.
